depiction.primary_object: rectangular speech bubble with a bottom-left tail
modifiers: three-node share symbol inside the bubble
depiction.composition: single outlined speech bubble containing a centered share graph icon

readings.meaning: social media post or social comment

ambiguity: Can be confused with a plain chat bubble or a generic share icon at very small sizes, or mistaken for a git branch / graph diagram inside a window.

modifier_semantics.modifier: three-node share symbol inside the bubble
modifier_semantics.meaning: sharing, forwarding, publishing to a social network, or distributing a message

repost community news or event details

draft a LinkedIn or Mastodon post

It fits a common family of tasks around posting on social networks and forwarding messages in group chats, while staying distinct from a plain chat bubble.
